choices.question: True/False? A conditional loop keeps repeating an action over and over UNTIL a specific rule tells it to stop.
True/False? Eating your cereal until your bowl is empty is an example of a conditional loop in the real world.
True/False? In Scratch, programmers use the "repeat until" block to create a conditional loop.
True/False? If you use a "repeat forever" block, the computer will stop on its own so you can program other actions.
True/False? When programming a shooting game, you can use a conditional loop to make a bullet move forward UNTIL it touches the edge of the screen.
True/False? In coding, the "IF" block is used to make choices, like "IF it rains, THEN use an umbrella".
